text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"The Oka Sho in full cherry blossom glory! 
The one who claimed the first tiara is—"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
What's this, Gentildonna... Talking that 
big, only to amount to this?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
No matter how good your reputation is, if 
you can't deliver results... what a 
letdown.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I shall accept it with grace. The defeated 
have no right to speak—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Very well, Trainer. You need not say 
another word.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Because I'm sure you only prepared words 
to praise the winner.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Why?
choice_data_list:
Because I probably won't ever need to 
comfort you again.

Because I probably won't need to comfort 
you anymore.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ... I could never forget that voice.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
The loser has no right to reject either 
solace or scorn.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I will wipe away this humiliation. With 
the praises of victory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying that, she closed her eyes... and in 
the next moment, Gentildonna had returned 
to her usual self.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Well, that makes our current position 
clear.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"At the Oaks, I will hone my power 
further... and unleash it to its fullest 
for you."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Gentile... She wasn't shaken in the 
slightest.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...She lost. So why... does it not feel 
like the gap between us has closed at 
all?"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...No, it's fine. Next time, I'll be the 
one pulling ahead.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: The Yushun Himba (Oaks)—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
No matter how great their strength, before 
a perfectly matched aptitude... they fall 
to their knees.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her next race: the Oaks— Tokyo Racecourse, 
2400 meters.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For Gentildonna, who has mainly run mile 
races up to this point, this distance and 
course are still unfamiliar territory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Considering Gentildonna's run today, it 
would be best to completely revise our 
training menu.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...Well, I wouldn't mind giving it a try 
for you.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It looks like the results will only make 
me feel like I wasted my time, though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...In other words, you wish to say no new 
countermeasures are needed. However, 
overconfidence is not part of my job—"
choice_data_list: No, the outcome will have you thanking me.
No, you'll end up thanking me for this.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if you'll still sound so 
confident once you know everything about 
me.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Hohoho...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Giving off a sense of unfathomable 
potential, we continue our training toward 
the second crown, the Oaks.
